name: Red Eyed Tree Frog (Agalychnis callidryas)
author: 3square
note: Native units appear arbitrary (extents ~2.5x3.5x1.1); body head-to-vent about 2.3 units, so scale about 19.5 for a 45 mm body. Sitting/crouched pose with eyes; sibling files eyes.stl and eyeless-looking.stl also exist on the page.
decimated: trimesh quadric decimation per body (body 1800 + eyes 2 x 100 = 2000 faces), scaled x 19.5 to mm
decimated_v7: eyeless body quadric-decimated to 2000 faces; eyes: Agalychnis-callidryas-eyes.stl (2 x 2194 faces) is the same eye mesh in another frame, so the identical eye bodies of looking.stl (same frame as the eyeless body) were used, decimated to 300 faces; both scaled x 19.5 to mm
